scope: Actual full-resolution video capture plus GPU detector and separate CPU identity worker on Slurm. Mock missing-RF branch only; no board deployment or ground-truth recovery accuracy.

snapshots.quality: Variance of Laplacian on grayscale native-box crop resized to height128 preserving aspect; select maximum, ties earlier source frame
snapshots.storage: JPEG95 native frame shared between tracks, plus lossless grayscale quality thumbnails; export selected native JPEG and lossless crop/oriented PNG derivatives. Source coordinates/hashes retained.
snapshots.orientation: A->B vertical-down passage: rotate crop90deg CCW; B->A rotate90deg CW so assumed movement points right; experimental motion-based assumption, not published rotated-box equivalence
snapshots.budget_scope: Retained JPEG plus quality-thumbnail bytes after admission; excludes codec transients, decoded frames, Python object overhead, inference runtime and model buffers.
snapshots.quality_evidence: Store the exact pre-JPEG resized grayscale thumbnail as lossless PNG; recompute Laplacian variance independently from those pixels.

rf: No real reader stream. Every predicted passage is explicitly RF_MOCK_MISSING; wait0.5source-video seconds before enqueue. Capture occurs before the wait ends. Events whose RF window extends beyond decoded source are censored, not forced missing.

worker.execution: Separate spawned process, CPU2threads, actual neural forward; foreground GPU detector1CPUthread, OpenCV1thread
worker.crop_selection: Single best from at most3recent candidates, no identity-score-based image selection
worker.service_policy: Nonpreemptible complete query in CPU worker; no claim of per-operator preemption
worker.post_eof: Measure and separately report results after frontend EOF; never hide drain as online throughput

identity.gallery: Same6 public evaluation-gallery identities,5registered images each, anonymous IDs only

review: No true cow labels for this raw source clip. Threshold crossings remain unverified candidate IDs, not verified ear-tag or herd records. New detector-crop domain is not recalibrated in this functional replay.
acceptance: Every predicted event has immutable snapshot/terminal status or explicit no-snapshot/capacity/censor/worker error reason
Native photo dimensions preserved; crop coordinates and rotation reproducible; selected source frame never later than passage event
All5conditions are true CPU model forwards on actual crop and fixed gallery
No silent queue failures; worker PID and parent PID distinct; results record source time vs wall monotonic separately
Snapshot-bank encoded bytes remain within32MiB; this excludes decoder/model/runtime memory
All source decode, model/threshold/gallery hashes, task timings and output artifacts reviewed; no PYNQ timing claim
